messages:
Priya Desai: Heads-up — Sales intake from NovaRetail. They need a private dedicated pool in us-west with a nightly batch-window SLA.

Monica Li: paste intake:
Priya Desai (message): "SLA: 99.95% availability during 01:00-03:00 PT nightly. Base throughput 8k reqs/min, burst to 40k reqs/min for up to 45 mins. Avg seq 200, p99 seq 768. Models: embeddings + 7B chat. No cross-region fallbacks. Go-live target 5 weeks."

Alex Gomez: Questions: is the 40k burst concurrent users or batched job? distribution across 45m? Any jitter?

Priya Desai: Sales says it's a scheduled ETL job peaking at run time — ramp from 1k -> 40k users in ~6 minutes, then steadies. Distribution roughly uniform after ramp. They need deterministic tail latency guarantees.

Mike Chen: Quick compute: 40k reqs/min => ~667 rps. With avg 200 tokens => 133k tokens/s. Need tokens/s per GPU to estimate. I'll run a microbench on 7B quantized to get tokens/sec on our us-west GPU types.

Sam Carter: Important: procurement needs committed numbers for contract. Can we present two proposals: full-reserved vs hybrid warm-pool? Also need clear warm-pool sizing and cost delta.

Monica Li: Proposed launch checklist: 1) perf validation in staging reproducing ramp; 2) autoscale policy + warm-pool to meet <6min ramp; 3) ops runbook + incident play; 4) legal approved SLA + no-fallback clause.

Alex Gomez: Draft autoscale policy idea (sketch):

```
policy_name: nova-retail-night-burst
base_reserve: 6 gpus
warm_pool: 6 gpus (preloaded models)
scale_max: 28 gpus
scale_strategy: warm-first, cold-fill async (120s)
burst_window: 45m
slo_priority: high
```

Priya Desai: Finance wants cost delta and a recommended option by Thu. Sales will push for hybrid if we can prove >=90% of bursts hit with warm_pool.

Mike Chen: I'll run two sims: (1) reserved sizing to sustain full 40k, (2) hybrid warm-pool + autoscale. I'll include latency tail, token cost, and KV-cache effect for chat flow. Running on staging starting 2026-03-26T04:00:00Z.

deploy-bot: scheduled: nova-retail-burst-test on staging 2026-03-26T04:00:00Z — results to #eng-runtime

infra-team: fyi, current GPU availability in us-west: A100X (limited), H100-equivalent (available), provisioning lead time 7–10 days for Reserved. Warm images can be prebuilt in ~2 hours.

Sam Carter: Action items:
- Mike: sims + GPU counts + cost delta by Wed EOD
- Alex: full autoscale policy + ops playbook draft by Wed
- Monica: assemble launch checklist + test plan
- Priya: confirm exact percentiles with customer and procurement timeline
- Sam: coordinate with infra on reservation window

Monica Li: I'll track acceptance criteria: perf (p95/p99), availability >=99.95 during window, rollback plan, and legal-approved SLA text.

Priya Desai: Thanks all — i'll push to Sales and cc Legal. :thumbsup:
